# Concurrent Transactions

## Overview

Tempo's concurrent nonce system lets a single account send multiple transactions in parallel,
without waiting for each one to confirm sequentially. By using different nonce keys, transactions
that don't conflict can execute simultaneously, significantly improving throughput for
high-activity accounts.

[See the Tempo Transactions specification](https://docs.tempo.xyz/protocol/transactions/spec-tempo-transaction)

## Recipes

These recipes assume you have [set up a Tempo client](/tempo).

### Send in Parallel

Submit multiple transactions at once with `Promise.all`. Viem assigns non-conflicting nonce keys
automatically.

:::code-group

```ts twoslash [example.ts]
// @twoslash-cache: {"v":1,"hash":"4eeb90d9612a0e8ef6e50d069b952f901e343bf7b7ce489a604c21c4625f20f4","data":""}
import { client } from './viem.config'

const [receipt1, receipt2] = await Promise.all([
  client.transaction.sendSync({
    data: '0xcafebabe00000000000000000000000000000001',
    to: '0xdeadbeefdeadbeefdeadbeefdeadbeefdeadbeef',
  }),
  client.transaction.sendSync({
    data: '0xdeadbeef00000000000000000000000000000002',
    to: '0xfeedfacefeedfacefeedfacefeedfacefeedface',
  }),
])
```

```ts twoslash [viem.config.ts] filename="viem.config.ts"
// @twoslash-cache: {"v":1,"hash":"a57ef5436b6bcd3f320cc085c065fe4b69419ffb0305348d36e1f041a72ebceb","data":""}
// [!include ~/snippets/tempo/viem.config.ts:setup]
```

:::

### Control Nonce Keys

For finer control, assign each transaction a distinct `nonceKey` so they cannot conflict. Nonce
keys must be greater than `0` (key `0` is reserved for protocol nonces).

:::code-group

```ts twoslash [example.ts]
// @twoslash-cache: {"v":1,"hash":"4409783f2c7df9a30522669bc114c87f5d1f5a180f07b2796ee828b7cd34967f","data":""}
import { client } from './viem.config'

const hash1 = await client.transaction.send({
  data: '0xcafebabe00000000000000000000000000000001',
  nonceKey: 567n, // [!code focus]
  to: '0xdeadbeefdeadbeefdeadbeefdeadbeefdeadbeef',
})
const hash2 = await client.transaction.send({
  data: '0xdeadbeef00000000000000000000000000000002',
  nonceKey: 789n, // [!code focus]
  to: '0xfeedfacefeedfacefeedfacefeedfacefeedface',
})
```

```ts twoslash [viem.config.ts] filename="viem.config.ts"
// @twoslash-cache: {"v":1,"hash":"a57ef5436b6bcd3f320cc085c065fe4b69419ffb0305348d36e1f041a72ebceb","data":""}
// [!include ~/snippets/tempo/viem.config.ts:setup]
```

:::

### Distinguish Expiring Transactions

Pass `nonceKey: 'expiring'` and a distinct `nonce` to distinguish otherwise identical
transactions. This nonce is an identifier and does not need to be sequential.

:::code-group

```ts twoslash [example.ts]
// @twoslash-cache: {"v":1,"hash":"54a9f801de5cb2eceb5eeaab4ee1011f74943773ae8a06b5e3eda08eadad2efa","data":""}
import { client } from './viem.config'

const hash = await client.transaction.send({
  nonceKey: 'expiring', // [!code focus]
  nonce: 42, // [!code focus]
  to: '0xdeadbeefdeadbeefdeadbeefdeadbeefdeadbeef',
})
```

```ts twoslash [viem.config.ts] filename="viem.config.ts"
// @twoslash-cache: {"v":1,"hash":"a57ef5436b6bcd3f320cc085c065fe4b69419ffb0305348d36e1f041a72ebceb","data":""}
// [!include ~/snippets/tempo/viem.config.ts:setup]
```

:::

Viem defaults an omitted nonce to a random 48-bit integer, so otherwise identical transactions stay distinct.
Use integers between `0` and `Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER`; Viem's nonce API uses JavaScript
`number` and does not support the full `uint64` range. For retries, reuse the signed transaction
so its nonce, validity window, and other signed fields stay identical.

An omitted `validBefore` defaults to 270 seconds from now. Tempo rejects expiring transactions
whose `validBefore` is more than `Expiry.expiringNonceMax` (300) seconds away.

### Read a Nonce

Read the current nonce for an account and nonce key with
[`nonce.get`](/tempo/actions/nonce.get).

:::code-group

```ts twoslash [example.ts]
// @twoslash-cache: {"v":1,"hash":"a55d5be8083e852ad53e436f5052d7894962a1d650030b4d3ff267be6a63fe91","data":""}
import { client } from './viem.config'

const nonce = await client.nonce.get({
  account: '0xcafebabecafebabecafebabecafebabecafebabe',
  nonceKey: 567n,
})
```

```ts twoslash [viem.config.ts] filename="viem.config.ts"
// @twoslash-cache: {"v":1,"hash":"a57ef5436b6bcd3f320cc085c065fe4b69419ffb0305348d36e1f041a72ebceb","data":""}
// [!include ~/snippets/tempo/viem.config.ts:setup]
```

:::

## Best Practices

### Use Distinct Nonce Keys per Stream

Give each independent stream of transactions its own `nonceKey`. Transactions that share a nonce
key are still ordered relative to each other, so reuse a key only when ordering matters and use
separate keys to maximize parallelism.

### Pass Explicit Nonces When Preparing Manually

When you call `client.transaction.prepare` with a keyed nonce, pass both `nonceKey` and `nonce`.
The node does not fill keyed nonces for manually prepared requests.
